messages.subject: MAPKIT: ERROR: malloc failed (hash.c, line 1332)
parts:
I am attempting to run a spacetime model and get the following error.

MAPKIT: ERROR: malloc failed (hash.c, line 1332)

The error occurs after it runs for a considerable time >10 hrs. 

#The formula...
formula.intII<- y ~ 1 + EP_UNEMP + EP_PCI + EP_NOHSDP + EP_AGE65 + EP_AGE17 + EP_DISABL + EP_SNGPNT + EP_MINRTY + EP_MOBILE + EP_CROWD + EP_NOVEH + EP_GROUPQ + EP_POV + EP_MUNIT + EP_LIMENG + EP_UNINSUR + f(ID.area,model="bym",graph=US.adj) +
  f(ID.year,model="rw2") + f(ID.year1,model="iid") +
  f(ID.area.int,model="iid", group=ID.year.int,control.group=list(model="rw2"))

 #The model
CovidModel.intII <- inla(formula.intII,family="poisson",data=CovidData,E=E, 
                  control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE), 
                  control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE), verbose = TRUE)

I have run the model as verbose but there is considerable text and I am not sure what the error means in the slightest.  Any idea what this error could mean?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] MAPKIT: ERROR: malloc failed (hash.c, line 1332)
parts:
You're running out of memory...

make sure ID.year.int is integers from 1, 2,3 ...

add

control.inla=list(int.strategy="eb", strategy="adaptive")

update to R-4.0 and the newest testing version


reduce number of threads, like

..., num.threads="4:1"

or lower


it that does not help, let us know

Best
H
